method: esbuild bundle+minify+treeShaking, format esm, target es2020, legalComments none. gzip = zlib level 9; brotli = zlib default. CSS measured (framework ships none). HTML = minimal module-boot shell. esbuild is a measurement-only bundler, not a streetui runtime dep.

minimal.description: Reactivity core + client renderer + BrowserDOMAdapter + DSL compile (counter-class app).

typical.description: Representative SPA: reactivity + render + router + forms/validators + i18n + store + resource + hydration.

full.description: Entire public `streetui` barrel (every exported member retained via import *).

realApp.description: The actual built demo application entry (examples/streetui-performance-app browser-entry).

cssPolicy.note: Framework ships no CSS; app-authored styles are out of scope.
